channel.title: EdSharp Walkthroughs
channel.description: Spoken walks through EdSharp, the text and code editor for working by ear. Twelve walks, each under five minutes, in the order a new person meets them.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 00 - Overview and Table of Contents
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-00-overview-and-table-of-contents

item.title: 01 - Install and Launch
item.description: The installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-01-install-and-launch

item.title: 02 - User Interface Concepts
item.description: EdSharp is open. Nothing needs pressing in this walk; it is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-02-user-interface-concepts

item.title: 03 - Key Patterns
item.description: EdSharp is open on an empty document. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-03-key-patterns

item.title: 04 - Open, Edit and Save a File
item.description: EdSharp is open, and letter.txt is in your Documents folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-04-open-edit-and-save-a-file

item.title: 05 - Find Your Way in a Long Document
item.description: A long document is open in EdSharp. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-05-find-your-way-in-a-long-document

item.title: 06 - Convert Between Formats
item.description: EdSharp is open, and report.docx is in your Documents folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-06-convert-between-formats

item.title: 07 - Write Code
item.description: EdSharp is open on a short Python file with one mistake, and Python was ticked when EdSharp was installed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-07-write-code

item.description: EdSharp is open on a document, and Ollama with a model was ticked when EdSharp was installed, or installed since. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-08-ask-the-ai-on-your-own-computer
